notablePrerequisites: You control at least six legendary enchantments.
description:
Activate Hei Bai by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} and tapping it, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token for each legendary enchantment you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar six times by sacrificing six Spirits, adding {W}{U}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Hei Bai.
Repeat.
